# autopilot (fixture)

The shipped defect, reproduced: the sentence tells the user to set a variable no
code reads. Nothing fails at runtime — the banners simply keep arriving, and the
value can only be chosen before the run starts.

- 「이 런의 배너를 전부 끄시려면 런을 시작하기 전에 `CC_CMDS_AUTOPILOT_BANNER=0` 을 걸어 주세요.」
